## 更新内容 / Changes

- 改进 Codex 桌面兼容性：启动时从已安装客户端的实际资源和语义结构探测页面语言、普通 / Fast 和 Ultra 能力，按功能独立降级。未知版本会保留官方原界面，不再因为版本号未登记而阻止启动；历史版本表只用于经过验证的回退路径。
- 支持新版打包器生成的顶层函数声明、函数表达式和箭头函数，检测到资源替换或应用程序更新时重新验证启动票据，避免把旧兼容结果写入新客户端。
- Codex npm CLI 不再要求管理器内置固定 launcher SHA。解析仍只接受标准 `@openai/codex` 包、当前平台依赖和包内原生可执行文件，不执行所选 JavaScript。
- 增加未来客户端、部分能力不可用、可执行文件替换、API / OAuth 实例和 CLI launcher 升级的回归覆盖。

- Improved Codex desktop compatibility: the manager now inspects the installed renderer's actual resources and semantic structure for locale, Normal / Fast and Ultra capabilities, with independent fallback per feature. Unknown versions keep the official UI instead of being blocked by an unlisted version; the historical table is only a verified fallback.
- Added support for top-level declarations, function expressions and arrow functions emitted by newer bundlers. Launch tickets are revalidated when resources or the application executable change, so stale compatibility results cannot write into a replacement client.
- Codex npm CLI resolution no longer requires a manager-bundled launcher SHA. It still accepts only the standard `@openai/codex` package, the current platform dependency and a package-owned native executable; selected JavaScript is never executed.
- Added regression coverage for future clients, partial feature availability, executable replacement, API / OAuth instances and upgraded CLI launchers.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。升级前请在方便时关闭管理器窗口；正在运行的实例会由后台服务继续保留，直到实例自行退出或被明确停止。账号、实例、会话和本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Close the manager window when convenient; running instances remain owned by the background service until they exit or are explicitly stopped. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。桌面菜单和语言适配会按已安装 Codex 的实际能力逐项启用；Fast 仍取决于客户端、模型和服务商能力。纯 API 连接不会凭空产生 ChatGPT OAuth 身份；保留真实 OAuth 身份并使用独立 API provider 的混合模式仍需单独接入。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Desktop menu and language integration are enabled per the installed Codex capabilities; Fast still depends on the client, model and provider. A pure API connection cannot create a ChatGPT OAuth identity; retaining a real OAuth identity while using an independent API provider remains a separate integration.

## 验证来源 / Verification

版本标签 `v0.4.12` 将指向完整来源提交；GitHub Actions “Build release” 会运行公开仓库检查、macOS arm64 源码测试、打包检查并生成附件校验值。安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

The `v0.4.12` tag will identify the complete source commit. GitHub Actions “Build release” will run the public repository check, macOS arm64 source tests, packaging checks and installer checksum generation. Installer hashes are provided in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
